qualitative.gate_2_reason: Sports nutrition supplements (Optimum Nutrition) and protein powders are non-essential discretionary lifestyle products that are easily forgone or substituted during economic downturns.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Essential Need & Everyday Habits, REJECT). Core earnings engine is sports nutrition (Optimum Nutrition), a consumer discretionary fitness lifestyle category subject to shifting consumer fads, brand turnover, and easily deferred spending during recessions, alongside volatile whey commodity input prices.
qualitative.evidence: Following the divestment of its legacy dairy business, Glanbia's primary growth and earnings driver is Performance Nutrition (~$1.8B sales, anchored by Optimum Nutrition). Sports supplements and whey protein powders are discretionary workout lifestyle products rather than essential Western staples or Lindy cultural rituals. Group ROCE sits at 11-12% and earnings are exposed to severe margin compression during whey commodity inflation cycles.
